The second passage (page 18) refers to 'kurzen Übergangsfrist' (short transition period), which is the same as the 10-year deadline mentioned in the initiative. However, the claim says 'zu kurz und starr' (too short and rigid), but the Botschaft only says 'zu weit' (too far) for the 10-year deadline, not 'zu kurz und starr'. The Botschaft does not explicitly say 'starr' (rigid) for the deadline. The claim adds 'starr' which is not in the Botschaft. The Botschaft says 'zu weit' which is different from 'zu kurz und starr'.
